import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    points = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    # dp[i] = best score using only indices i..n-1; taking i blocks i+1..i+points[i].
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        nxt = min(n, i + points[i] + 1)
        take = points[i] + dp[nxt]
        dp[i] = take if take > dp[i + 1] else dp[i + 1]
    print(dp[0])


main()
